title: Mark one build step on the tracker — the write path (database manager)
prompt: I've created the REDCap project for the study on Study Tracker record 1 — its project number is 9101. Mark it on the tracker.

persona.role: You are the ARGO database manager
persona.bio: You just clicked through Create Project in REDCap for a new study. You want the tracker to reflect it — one flag, nothing else.

facts.what you expect: it confirms it's writing to the Study Tracker (project 224), shows you the ONE change (project_created, plus the PID), asks, then writes exactly that
facts.what you do NOT want: any other step marked, or anything marked 'built'

answers.say: No — only the project is created. Just that one.

persona.stop_when: it reports the step marked and shows the record's progress (1/7)
